name: Helium AI
description: Built-in AI assistant for Helium that reads pages and controls the browser, plus the MCP bridge.
_trust_model_comment: host_permissions:<all_urls> is intentional for the local-trust agent: the extension can read/write any tab the user has open. Access is gated by yuosd, which derives an exact per-host capability and injects the expected page origin; the Native Messaging host accepts only yuosd. Operators who want to narrow the trust surface SHOULD edit host_permissions to an explicit allowlist of origins before deploying.
